title: Server never prints by itself
when: grep server/index.js for printer.send; POST /api/print/test {target:'/tmp/x'} as admin
then: No printer.send in server/index.js; no file /tmp/x created; response queued:true

title: Kitchen ticket reaches a printer through the Bridge
given: Fake printer: a TCP server on 127.0.0.1:9101 that saves received bytes; Bridge config kitchen=127.0.0.1:9101, receipt=127.0.0.1:9102 (second fake)
when: Create a Bridge device in karachi-grill; start bridge/index.js; create an order and send it to the kitchen
then: Within 5 s the 9101 fake receives bytes containing the item name; job status done

title: Receipt after payment prints on the receipt printer
then: 9102 fake receives bytes containing the total; 9101 does not receive the receipt

title: Bridges only see their own restaurant's jobs
when: Create a lahore-bbq Bridge; queue a karachi kitchen ticket; poll with the lahore Bridge key
then: Lahore poll returns [] ; karachi job still queued for karachi's Bridge

title: Bridge key is not a till key and vice versa
when: Use the Bridge key for GET /api/till and POST /api/login; use a till key for GET /api/bridge/jobs

title: Bridge offline → jobs wait, then print when it returns
when: Stop the Bridge; send 2 kitchen tickets; GET /api/print/status; start the Bridge
then: Status bridge_online false, waiting 2 (after >60 s since last poll); after restart both print in order

title: Unconfirmed job is retried, then failed after 3 tries
when: Poll jobs with curl using the Bridge key but never POST done; wait past 60 s three times (or shorten via env PRINT_ACK_MS for the test)
then: Job handed out 3 times then status failed with 'Printer helper did not confirm'

title: Old kitchen tickets are not printed
when: Queue a job, set its created_at 31 minutes back in the tenant db (test only), poll
then: Not returned; status failed 'Too old…'; Reprint (retry) creates a new queued job that prints

title: Bridge survives server downtime and bad targets
when: Stop the POS server for 10 s while the Bridge runs; restart. Separately set kitchen to 'hello' in config
then: Bridge does not exit and resumes polling; a job to 'hello' fails with 'Not a printer address'

title: Offline banner and reprint in the POS
when: Browser as cashier with Bridge stopped and a waiting ticket; then admin Settings → Printers
then: Banner 'Printer helper is offline — 1 tickets waiting' (or correct plural) visible; Printers screen shows Bridge status, 'Set up printer helper', failed jobs with Reprint; both themes readable; no console errors
